kinetic_fitting_autocatalysis_1.name: Photocatalytic Mechanism Discovery (Autocatalysis) - Trial 1
kinetic_fitting_autocatalysis_1.description:
CONTEXT: The [Ru] dependence curve suggests catalyst inhibition at high concentrations (more Ru = less O2 production), indicating formation of inactive species or aggregation, possibly via dimer formation. The kinetic profile shows a characteristic lag phase followed by rapid deactivation. The initial network provides basic photochemistry - expand it with reactions explaining concentration-dependent inhibition.

HINT: Consider autocatalytic mechanisms where inactive species catalyze their own formation (e.g., dimer-catalyzed dimerization).

NOTE: The evaluate_phenomenological_trends function is expensive, so verify your hypotheses with fit_single_experiment before proceeding with the evaluation.

GOAL: Achieve Phenomenological Score > 0.75.
kinetic_fitting_autocatalysis_1.submission_format: Final score based on phenomenological trend reproduction (target: >0.75)
